lines:
Use the current tool list and [Atlas host compatibility](../../../FRAMEWORK-RUNTIME.md)
as the authority. Skill instructions do not install or enable multi-agent tools.
Use the available spawn, follow-up, messaging and waiting tools only when the
task authorizes delegation. A standalone skill never changes Codex settings.
Inherit the parent's model and effort by default. If an explicit user request
or applicable instruction selects another model, use a permitted isolated fork
and the exact arguments accepted by the current tool. Full-history forks may
reject overrides. Do not invent a missing tool or a supported model name.
Keep working while children run. When idle, use a bounded wait that respects
the host's communication cadence; report meaningful progress to the user.
